overview:
Ami Bera seeks another term in a Sacramento-area district that leans Democratic by six points. He has raised roughly $1.4 million and holds $1.65 million on hand, while Republican Robb Tucker has raised about $294,000 with under $30,000 remaining. No outside groups have spent against Bera, and no public polls of the race are available.

Prediction markets put Bera's chances at 95 to 96 percent, and the fundamentals point the same way: the district's lean, his incumbency, and the money gap all favor him. The forecast expects a comfortable Bera win, though uncertainty is wider than usual because no polls test the matchup. A late influx of outside money or an unexpected shift in the national environment would be the most plausible sources of surprise.
